Athens, Greece, 17th - 21st February, 2025 Agenda item: 4.2.4 Document for: Discussion and Endorsement Introduction This contribution intends to suggest a recommendation/guidance to be provided by RAN5 leadership in order to reduce the number of overall CRs treated during each meeting. Discussion Treatment of discussion paper but especially CRs is a time-intensive task for various parties involved: MCC: implementation of CRs into specs once agreed RAN5 chairs/vice chairs/convenors/secretaries/assistants: tracking/revising CRs in the respective spreadsheets and databases Delegates: review/discussion/tracking of CRs internally (meeting preparation) and tracking of CRs during the meeting It is therefore in everyone’s best interest to limit the number of contributions and CRs as much as possible. In RAN4, the RAN4 leadership has formally enforced the number of contributions (discussion, LS, simulations, draft CR/TPs, etc.) for a number of years already [1] and is reminding delegates in their ‘RAN4#X meeting Arrangements and Guidelines’ document every meeting, e.g., RAN5 obviously has their agenda and TDoc reservation setup very differently than RAN4, e.g., the same spec can be discussed in vastly different agenda items/WIs and different sub-agenda items can be assigned to different clauses of the same spec. In order to optimize the handling of contributions, it is suggested for RAN5 leadership to periodically provide a recommendation to the group to encourage each company to limit the number of contributions (discussion papers and CRs) and/or consolidate TDocs for each agenda item to reduce the number of contributions. Especially, editorial and RAN4 alignment CRs submitted per agenda by each company item should be combined to avoid multiple CRs in the same agenda item. Whether this guidance should be captured in a PRD, e.g., PRD18 (“General processes and practices”), could be discussed separately. We realize that there are exceptions and sometimes separate CRs to a TR/TS might be needed, e.g., essential corrections. Proposal 1: RAN5 leadership to periodically provide a recommendation to the group for each company to limit the number of contributions (discussion papers and CRs) and/or consolidate TDocs for each agenda item to reduce the number of contributions Proposal 2: RAN5 leadership to provide a guidance to the group to make sure that companies combine editorial and RAN4 alignment CRs submitted per agenda item to avoid multiple CRs with similar/same intent in the same agenda item. Conclusion The following observations and conclusions were made in this contribution. Proposal 1: RAN5 leadership to periodically provide a recommendation to the group for each company to limit the number of contributions (discussion papers and CRs) and/or consolidate TDocs for each agenda item to reduce the number of contributions Proposal 2: RAN5 leadership to provide a guidance to the group to make sure that companies combine editorial and RAN4 alignment CRs submitted per agenda item to avoid multiple CRs with similar/same intent in the same agenda item.
